title: decision(process): every dispatchable card in `domain:spec` @ objectui is parked behind `pm:retriage`, and this repository has no triage seat to answer them
body:
## 维护者速读

`domain:spec` @ objectui 这条车道今天**一张卡都派不出去**,不是因为没活,是因为活全卡在一个不存在的人手上。

这条车道现在 41 张开着的卡,其中够格派工的只有 11 张;这 11 张里 10 张都挂着「请分诊席复核」的标记,1 张的负责人是别人。挂标记的是我自己——每次都是我在派工前发现卡本身有问题(路由写错了、这其实是道选择题不是执行卡、卡自己写着"我还不能派"、上游裁决其实指向相反方向),按规矩把疑问写清楚交给分诊席裁,自己不动手改。**规矩没问题,问题是 objectui 这个仓根本没有分诊席**——三张在编的席位是 devx、spec(我)、ui,没有分诊。所以这 10 张卡从昨天上午挂上去到现在 18 个小时,一张也没人答,还在往上堆。

我不能自己答自己提的疑问:这套两席分工存在的唯一理由,就是提疑问的人不同时是裁疑问的人。真让我自己答,这条规矩当场作废,而且是在它最该生效的地方作废。

三个选择:

- **A**:给 objectui 配一个分诊席。根治,但要新开一个会话/人手,今天这 10 张还得等它上线。
- **B**:授权我自己答自己提的疑问(可以加条件,比如只限路由和状态更正、逐条留裁决理由、给你否决窗口)。今天就能解锁,代价是把独立复核这道闸门在它最该拦的地方拆掉。
- **C**:让 objectui 已有的另一个席位(devx 或 ui)代跑一轮分诊,一次性把这 10 张答完。今天就能解锁,不用新人手,答的人跟提的人不是同一个,闸门还在;代价是占掉那个席位的一轮。

我的建议是 **C** 先解今天的堵,再走 **A** 做长期;**B** 我不建议,理由如上。

选哪个:A / B / C?

os-decision-facets

- ① 项目长远合理性:C 与 A 都不新增特例,走的是既有的"分诊空缺时可代跑"通道;B 要新造一条"自己答自己"的永久例外,这类例外一旦开了就会被后面每一张不好答的卡引用。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天就撞上——这条车道 10 张卡、18 小时、零答复,且还在涨;开发产能空着,不是没活。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:B 最危险。同一个席位既提疑问又裁疑问,出错时没有任何人会看见——症状是"卡顺利派出去了",一个沉默的通过;C 保留了第二双眼睛,错会被响亮地挡下来。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:C 不新增任何常设职责,用完即止;A 新增一个常设席位,但那是这个仓本来就该有的;B 表面上最省,实际是给每一张未来的卡都加了一条永久的自裁授权。
- 推荐:**C**(回退:A)。
- 本分析看不见什么:我看不见给 devx 或 ui 席位加一轮的真实代价——它们各自的队列深度和在飞承诺我没读;也看不见维护者手上是否已有一个准备上线的分诊席。这两点任一成立都可能把答案从 C 推向 A。

---

## What is actually blocking, measured

Read from `objectstack-ai/objectui` at **2026-09-15T04:00Z**, `list_issues` with `labels: [domain:spec]`, `state: OPEN`: **`totalCount` 41, returned 41** — the enumeration is complete, ⛔ not a page of it.

Of those 41, the dispatchable population under the seat's own rule (open · unassigned · carries the queue label · no `needs-user-decision` · no `pm:retriage`) is **zero**. The breakdown:

| bucket | count | cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pm:queue` **+ `pm:retriage`** — waiting on a triage answer | **10** | #9091 · #8946 · #8924 · #8831 · #8801 · #8628 · #8236 · #7997 · #7924 · #7759 |
| `pm:queue`, assigned to someone else | 1 | #4356 (`yinlianghui`) |
| `needs-user-decision` — already in the decision box | 6 | #9263 · #8961 · #8800 · #8603 · #8572 · #7911 |
| `pm:blocked` | 13 | incl. #9309, moved there this round |
| `pm:on-hold` | 5 | |
| `pm:dispatched` (in flight) | 5 | incl. 3 held by this seat |
| no pm-state at all (a triage half-state, also nobody's) | 1 | #9491 |
| **dispatchable** | **0** | — |

**Who hung the ten, and when.** Every one was hung by this seat, from the timeline `labeled` events:

| card | hung at | history |
|---|---|---|
| #8946 | 2026-09-14T10:12:23Z | first and only |
| #7997 | 2026-09-14T10:26:02Z | first and only |

| #8924 | 2026-09-14T13:44:16Z | first and only |

⚠️ `claude[bot]` and `os-sam` are the same seat writing through two channels (raw REST vs MCP), so "two actors" in the raw event data is one seat, not two. **Oldest unanswered: 17 h 48 m at the time of reading. Cleared since the vacancy: one, and that one was re-hung.**

**What they ask.** Read from the disagreement comment nearest each label event (within 16 seconds in every case), they are four recognisable shapes, and not one is a grading opinion dressed up as a question:

- *the card is routed to the wrong lane* — #8628 (already ruled, and the ruling assigns execution to `domain:ui` while the card carries `domain:spec`), #7924;
- *this is a decision, not an execution card* — #8831, #7759, #8801, #8236 (three of these say so in their own body text and are sitting in the dispatch queue anyway);
- *the card's premise is falsified* — #9091 (the dev stopped before its first edit and was right to: the ruling this seat cited authorises the opposite), #7997 (this seat's own earlier comment on the card is false, and it is the binding-looking one), #8924;
- *a hold's restart condition is still not met* — #8946, which by the state model belongs in `pm:on-hold`, not `pm:queue`.

## Governing text

- `SKILL.md`: `执行座位信任标签,只在本车道认领;误标 ⛔ 不自行改,挂 pm:retriage + 异议评论同笔` — the seat raising the objection may not resolve it.
- `SKILL.md`: `retriage 维持或改判皆由分诊席同笔摘标;挂标归异议席` — maintaining or overturning is the triage seat's write, and the label comes off in that same write.
- `SKILL.md`: `多车道仓分诊空缺时,会话型执行 PM 可代扫:只做分诊动作,不跨车道认领,贴上注明` — this is the provision option **C** rests on, and it is why C needs no new rule, only a decision about whose round pays for it.
- `SKILL.md`: `⛔ 不跨车道借调` — which is why C is put to you rather than simply done: asking another lane's seat to spend a round on this lane's cards is the thing that rule names.
- `SKILL.md`: `任何跨座位请求都是工作:一律立卡进目标车道队列` — under C the request lands as a card in the chosen lane's queue, ⛔ not as a comment on a seat post.

## Premises, with the commands to re-check them

1. **objectui has no triage seat.** `list_issues labels=[pm:seat] state=OPEN` → `totalCount` **3**, returned 3: #5748 `domain:devx`, #5734 `domain:spec`, #5560 `domain:ui`. ⚠️ #5748's title carries the string `triage #6015 still 🔴`; **#6015 in this repository is a closed pull request** (`fix(plugin-detail): give record:path one stage classification both rows read`, closed, labels `plugin`/`tests`), so that reference does not resolve to a triage seat here and the vacancy stands as measured.
2. **No existing card covers this.** Semantic search over this repository for the vacancy and the backlog returned **1** unrelated hit (#5358, a closed QA re-test). ⛔ A single unrelated hit is a weak absence; re-run before treating this card as the only one.
3. **The ten are genuinely unanswered**, not answered-and-not-cleared: zero `unlabeled` events for `pm:retriage` on nine of them, and two on #8236 followed by a third `labeled`.

## The cost of doing nothing, stated plainly

The lane's development capacity is idle by construction, not by choice: with four PRs in flight and a concurrency ceiling of three devs, slots free up and there is nothing legal to put in them. Meanwhile the backlog grows — every card this seat reaches at the head of the queue and finds mis-routed adds an eleventh, a twelfth. ⛔ This seat will not clear its own objections to keep the slots warm, and will keep the rest of the queue moving in the meantime (landings, reviews and the decision box are unaffected).

## Execution after the ruling — so this only needs a direction, not a plan

- **A** ⇒ this seat does nothing but wait and keep landing; the new triage seat takes the ten in its first round, oldest first.
- **B** ⇒ this seat answers the ten in one batch, each with a recorded rationale naming the authority it relies on, all ten listed in the round report for a veto window, and ⛔ no grading and no `domain:*` write beyond what the answer itself requires.
- **C** ⇒ this seat files one request card in the chosen lane's queue (`domain:ui` or `domain:devx`, your pick — name it in the reply, or say "either" and I will take the shallower queue by measurement), listing the ten with a one-line statement of what each asks, and moves each answered card to its new state as the answers come back.
